insight.title: Your Phone Weighs More When the Battery Is Full
insight.subtitle: Why energy and data have a physical weight you can measure.

sections.text: Your phone is heavier when the battery is full. Storing power isn't just a digital change; you are literally packing more physical mass into the palm of your hand.
Storing energy increases the total mass of an object. While the difference is microscopic, a charged battery weighs more than a dead one because energy and matter are fundamentally the same thing.
This applies to your data, too. A hard drive full of photos weighs more than an empty one. Your digital life isn't invisible; it is a physical burden on your hardware.
Every photo you save adds actual weight to your pocket.
